title: Healthcare Cloud Migration
background: A healthcare provider is evaluating cloud migration for patient-facing and back-office applications.
candidate_prompt: How would you evaluate the situation and recommend what the organization should do next?
good_answer_includes: Considers cost, security, compliance, and downtime
great_answer_includes: Segments workloads by complexity and risk
Compares rehost, refactor, and replace options
Includes change management and operating model needs
Defines migration waves and success metrics
interviewer_notes: A strong candidate should use a clear cloud migration structure, isolate the most important drivers, and connect the recommendation to business impact.
